items.title: Chico Hamilton — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

ctx.x: This is just because of your Relationship -- because the signing was -- or did you have a previous relationship?

No previous relationship. I just signed with him. I had met him when I was with Lena, years ago when I was with Lena and then I saw him, you know, from time to time, you know. He’s a dynamite dude, man, unbelievable. And we signed with Reprise but they weren’t ready for jazz, you know at that time. But anyway to make a long story short, but, you know, after a while when nothing was happening, I realized nothing -- you know, I wanted out.

And I was playing at the Vanguard and Sinatra was in town. He was doing that thing at Carnegie Hall and George came down to the Vanguard to see me and I told him, George, I really want to get out of my contract. He says okay, I’ll talk to -- come on, you want to see the boss? I said yeah. So after the gig man we come on up to Jilly’s, right, we go into Jilly’s. You can’t even get nowhere near there man, people are just like this, you know, and they see George, they let George and me in. Man, in the back room,…
